# PhantomRank

> AI Search Intelligence built for brands and marketing agencies. Monitor your brand visibility, citations, and share of voice in real-time across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Grok, and Copilot.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.phantomrank.com/): AI Search Intelligence built for brands and marketing agencies.
- [Pricing](https://www.phantomrank.com/pricing): Simple, transparent pricing plans built for brands and boutique agencies.
- [Use Cases](https://www.phantomrank.com/use-cases): Industry-specific playbooks for tracking and optimizing AI search visibility.
- [Learn Hub](https://www.phantomrank.com/learn): In-depth guides and articles about Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).
- [Sign Up](https://www.phantomrank.com/signup): Request access to start tracking your brand's AI search engine visibility.

## Learn Hub Categories

- [AI-Powered SEO](https://www.phantomrank.com/learn/ai-powered-seo): Guides on building search and content strategies optimized for AI engine visibility and citations.
- [AI Search Agency Strategy](https://www.phantomrank.com/learn/ai-search-agency-strategy): Playbooks for marketing agencies to package, sell, and report on client AI search performance.
- [AI Visibility Tracking](https://www.phantomrank.com/learn/ai-visibility-tracking): How to monitor brand citations, mentions, and share of voice across conversational models.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://www.phantomrank.com/learn/answer-engine-optimization): Optimizing websites for conversational search platforms and AI answer generation.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://www.phantomrank.com/learn/generative-engine-optimization): Specific optimization techniques to earn organic citations inside AI results.
